finalDecision.unitType: stable proverb clause with repeated Chan deployment
finalDecision.preferredTarget: wine is drunk with one who understands
alternateTargets: drink wine with a kindred spirit

finalDecision.meaning: The clause marks something offered or said when the other person truly understands; no special mystical meaning is assigned to literal wine or drinking.
finalDecision.companionLine: 詩向會人吟 confirms the parallel proverb but is not a second sense; 花插美人頭 shows that the first clause remains stable when the paired line varies.
